title: A Walk Through Kyoto
desc: 竹林、老街和小餐馆，慢慢走一遍京都。

vocab.ex: Kyoto is famous for its temples and its quiet streets.
vocab.exZh: 京都是以寺庙和安静街道而闻名的城市。

vocab.ex: You can walk down a narrow lane and hear only your own steps.
vocab.exZh: 你可以沿着一条狭窄的小巷漫步。

vocab.ex: The city feels peaceful, even when many visitors are there.
vocab.exZh: 即使有许多游客，这座城市依然让人感到宁静。

vocab.en: a tall plant with hard stems
vocab.ex: A bamboo forest rises high above the path.
vocab.exZh: 一片竹林高高耸立在小路之上。

vocab.en: a custom passed down over time
vocab.ex: It is a good place to enjoy a tradition that is more than a thousand years old.
vocab.exZh: 这是一个感受一项一千多年历史的传统的好地方。

vocab.en: to try food by eating a little of it
vocab.ex: You can taste food that Kyoto has cooked for centuries.
vocab.exZh: 你可以品尝京都烹制了几个世纪的食物。

en: Kyoto is an old city in Japan, famous for its temples and its quiet streets.
In the morning, you can walk down a narrow lane and hear only your own steps.
The city feels peaceful, even when many visitors are there.
zh: 京都是日本的一座古城，以寺庙和安静的街道而闻名。
早晨，你可以沿着一条狭窄的小巷漫步，只听见自己的脚步声。
即使有许多游客，这座城市依然让人感到宁静。

en: In the west of the city, a bamboo forest rises high above the path, and the green light feels like another world.
People come here to take photos, but many just stand and listen to the wind in the bamboo.
It is a good place to slow down and enjoy a tradition that is more than a thousand years old.
zh: 在城市的西边，一片竹林高高耸立在小路之上，绿色的光线仿佛是另一个世界。
人们来这里拍照，但许多人只是站着，聆听竹林中的风声。
这是一个放慢脚步的好地方，去感受一项一千多年历史的传统。

en: In the evening, small restaurants open their doors, and you can taste food that Kyoto has cooked for centuries.
The food is simple, but every dish is made with care.
When you leave Kyoto, you take its quiet streets with you, at least in your memory.
zh: 傍晚，小餐馆打开店门，你可以品尝京都烹制了几个世纪的食物。
食物很简单，但每一道菜都做得很用心。
当你离开京都，你会把它的安静街道带走，至少留在记忆里。

phrases.en: To walk along or down something.
phrases.ex: You can walk down a narrow lane and hear only your own steps.
phrases.exZh: 你可以沿着一条小巷走下去，只听见自己的脚步声。

phrases.en: To want to do something; to seem like.
phrases.ex: I didn't feel like working yesterday, so I called in sick.
phrases.exZh: 我昨天不想工作，所以请了病假。

phrases.ex: When approaching a bend in the road, slow down.
